overview.title: Credits
overview.subtitle: A single balance for everything that costs money in Decatron

blocks.x: Credits are the balance Decatron uses to pay for the features that have a real cost to the platform: premium voice, live translation, the LoL coach, the `!ia` command and AI chat. Each feature is charged according to what it really costs.
What runs on our own server, such as the standard voice, does not use credits: it has its own quota included in the plan. The bot, commands and overlays are free.

head: Source
How it works
rows: Each paid plan grants credits every month. They are spent first and renew on the 1st.
You pay with a card or Yape and receive an electronic receipt. Purchased credits do not expire and are used when the monthly ones run out.
While the transition lasts, accounts without a plan receive a courtesy balance.

blocks.x: If you have an account, the manual for your balance, purchases and receipts is in the dashboard help center:

balance.title: Credits: balance and spending
balance.subtitle: What you have, what it is spent on and how the history looks

blocks.x: Open Créditos (`/credits`). The balance belongs to the channel: every feature with a cost uses it, no matter who on the team turns them on.

head: Item
What it means
rows: The total you can spend now: the monthly part plus the purchased part.
What your plan grants and how much you have used. It renews on the 1st.
They do not expire; they are used when the monthly part runs out.
The standard voice characters you have left this month. It is a separate quota that does not touch credits.

blocks.x: The plan's monthly credits are 150,000 on Supporter, 500,000 on Premium and 1,500,000 on Fundador; the free plan includes none. The standard voice quota is 1,000,000, 3,000,000, 6,000,000 and 10,000,000 characters, from free to Fundador respectively.
When your plan expires, the page tells you; purchased credits are not lost. If you are in the transition window you will see a courtesy balance with its deadline.
Without credits the coach, live translation, `!ia` and AI chat are paused. The standard voice keeps working.

A breakdown by item of what was spent since the start of the period: LoL coach (AI and voice), live translation (listening, translating and voice), `!ia`, Decatron Chat, event alerts, Speak Chat, timers and tips.

The “Cómo se gastan” table shows what each thing costs today: listening for translation (per second spoken), premium voice (per character), the coach and translation AI calls (approximate, based on the model's real tokens) and the standard voice, which is free. These rates are set by the platform and may change, so that table is the current reference.
Every movement is recorded, with date, feature, detail and credits, and can be filtered by feature. The types are:

head: Type
What it is
rows: The reset of plan credits on the 1st.
Credits given back, for example if a voice synthesis failed.
An audio that already existed and was not charged.

buy.title: Credits: buying
buy.subtitle: Packages, payment by card or Yape and what you receive

items: Only the channel owner can buy credits. An editor with permissions will see the notice “Solo el dueño del canal puede comprar créditos”.
You must have your billing data complete (asked for only once). If it is missing, the purchase asks you to complete it before continuing.

blocks.x: Under “Comprar créditos” you will see the available packages, with how many credits they include, the price in dollars, a “popular” tag on the recommended one and, if there is one, a gift of extra credits. Each package shows the approximate price per million credits.
The packages and their prices are set by the platform and may change. If there are no packages, the page says “No hay paquetes disponibles por ahora”.

items: Check the preview of your receipt: type, name, document and subtotal.
Pay by card or Yape in the Culqi window.
Once the payment is confirmed, credits are added instantly and “¡Listo! Recibiste N créditos” appears. Your receipt arrives in a few minutes.

blocks.x: The price is in dollars and the charge is made in soles, at the platform's fixed exchange rate. Purchased credits do not expire.

items: If the bank rejects the payment, you will see the reason reported by the gateway and nothing is charged.
If the charge reached you but the page did not confirm the purchase, do not pay again: write to support with your payment receipt.
If the electronic receipt fails, your credits are credited anyway and the team resolves it.

blocks.x: At the bottom of the page, “Tus compras” lists each purchase with the date, credits, amount paid and the status of the receipt (“Factura” or “Boleta”, “en emisión…” if it has not been issued yet).

billing.title: Billing data and receipts
billing.subtitle: Who appears on your receipt and how to download it

blocks.x: In My account → Billing data (`/me/billing`) you fill in, once, the data used to issue your receipt or invoice when you buy something. If you only use Decatron for free, you do not need to fill them in.
First you choose where your address is, because that decides the type of receipt:

head: Address
Allowed documents
Receipt
rows: DNI, RUC (allows requesting an invoice), foreigner ID card or passport.
Electronic sales receipt with IGV included, or invoice with IGV if you have a RUC and ask for it.
Document of your country of residence (RUT, DNI, CUIT…), passport, foreigner ID card, TIN, IN or diplomatic ID.

items: RUC: 11 digits starting with 10, 15, 16, 17 or 20. When you type it, Decatron queries SUNAT and fills in the legal name (and the address if you did not enter one); that legal name cannot be changed, because the registered one must appear on the invoice.
Foreigner ID card: 9 to 12 characters. Passport: 5 to 12.
The RUC only exists in Peru: with an address outside the country, use the document of your country.
Address and email for the receipt are optional.

blocks.x: Receipt data is frozen with each purchase: if you change your profile later, earlier purchases keep the data they were made with.

Before paying, the “Tu comprobante” window shows exactly which document will be issued: invoice or receipt, name, document and subtotal. If you have a RUC you can choose an invoice instead of a receipt. For exports it is always an invoice and without IGV.
In My account → My receipts (`/me/invoices`) are all your receipts: those for your plan, for DecaCoins and for credits. Each one shows the type, number, date, amount and its status:

head: Status
Meaning
rows: The receipt is valid and can be downloaded.
It is still being generated; it usually takes a couple of minutes. Come back and it will be here.
You do not need to pay again: the purchase is already credited and the team reviews it.

blocks.x: It is downloaded in three formats: PDF (to print or save), XML (the signed file, the one that counts before SUNAT) and CDR (the proof that SUNAT received it).

coinsOverview.title: DecaCoins
coinsOverview.subtitle: The platform's currency, for the card game, the Wheel and the Gacha

blocks.x: DecaCoins are Decatron's currency. They are different from credits (which pay for AI, premium voice and translation) and from Twitch channel points. Decatron sells them: no channel feature can give them away.

head: How you get them
What you spend them on
rows: Buying them by card, in packages or in an amount you choose.
Packs and card upgrades in the collectible game.
Receiving them from another account, or as a gift from the team.

blocks.x: With an account, the manual for buying, transfers and referrals is in the help panel:

coins.title: DecaCoins: buying, transfers and referrals
coins.subtitle: Your balance, how to buy, send to another account and invite friends

blocks.x: Go to My account → DecaCoins (`/me/coins`). Your balance is at the top.

items: Packages: the ones the page shows, with their price in dollars.
Custom amount: from 100 to 5,000 coins per purchase; 100 coins equal US$1.
Discount code: if you have one, type it before buying to see the reduced prices.

blocks.x: Payment is by card, in the Culqi form. The price in dollars is charged in soles at the exchange rate of the moment. Before paying you confirm your billing details and, when done, you get your electronic receipt in My account → My receipts.

Under Transfer Coins you look the person up by username, type the amount and, if you want, a message. There are limits set by the platform: a minimum amount per transfer, a minimum age of the sending and receiving accounts, and a maximum number of transfers and amount per day.
An account with a suspended economy cannot transfer or receive.

Each account has a referral code and a link to share. When someone signs up with your code and meets the minimum activity the platform sets, the referral is completed and both accounts receive a coin bonus.

items: If someone invited you, type their code under Apply referral code (only one can be applied).
The page shows how many people you invited, how many referrals are completed or pending and the bonus you earned.

blocks.x: The Transaction history lists each movement with its date, the type (purchase, received, sent, referral, gift or team adjustment), the amount, the resulting balance and a description.

head: Where
How
rows: You buy packs in the shop and pay for your cards' level upgrades.
With `!dcomprar <coins>` you exchange coins for a channel's wheel credits.
With `!gcbuy [n]` you buy pulls with coins.
